vectors.name: signing_request
vectors.description: Signing request with one DESCRIPTOR (alias "main", FORM 0x01 descriptor wpkh([00000000/84h/1h/0h]xpub/0/*), POR of 4 bytes of 0x5a), a 19-byte PSBT holding an empty version 2 transaction, WANT_KIND present and set to 0x02 (signatures only), and ACCEPT_TRIMMED 0x00 (false).

vectors.name: signing_request_accept_trimmed
vectors.description: signing_request with WANT_KIND set to 0x01 (PSBT) and ACCEPT_TRIMMED 0x01 (true): a KIND 0x01 answer may leave out fields of the request's PSBT.

vectors.name: signing_response_psbt
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x01, carrying back the same 19-byte PSBT.

vectors.name: signing_response_signatures
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with one signature of every SIG_KIND: input 0 SIG_KIND 0x01 (segwit) with a 33-byte compressed key and a 71-byte signature, input 1 SIG_KIND 0x02 (tapkey) with a 64-byte signature, input 2 SIG_KIND 0x03 (taptree) with a 32-byte x-only key, a 32-byte leaf hash and a 65-byte signature. Every SIG_ENTRY carries the LENGTH of its KIND_FIELDS after SIG_KIND.

vectors.name: signing_response_musig_pub_nonces
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with two SIG_KIND 0x04 (musig pubnonce) entries, one per slot: input 0 with a 33-byte compressed PARTICIPANT, a 33-byte AGGREGATE of 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x11, LEAF_HASH absent (key path, presence byte 0x00) and a 66-byte PUB_NONCE of 0x22; input 1 with the same PARTICIPANT, a 33-byte AGGREGATE of 0x03 then 32 bytes of 0x33, LEAF_HASH present (presence byte 0x01) as 32 bytes of 0x44 (script path) and a 66-byte PUB_NONCE of 0x55. PUB_NONCE has no LENGTH prefix. Every SIG_ENTRY carries the LENGTH of its KIND_FIELDS after SIG_KIND.

vectors.name: signing_response_musig_partial_sigs
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with two SIG_KIND 0x05 (musig partial sig) entries over the same two slots: input 0 with the 33-byte compressed PARTICIPANT, AGGREGATE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x11, LEAF_HASH absent (presence byte 0x00) and a 32-byte PARTIAL_SIG of 0x66; input 1 with the same PARTICIPANT, AGGREGATE 0x03 then 32 bytes of 0x33, LEAF_HASH present (presence byte 0x01) as 32 bytes of 0x44 and a 32-byte PARTIAL_SIG of 0x77. PARTIAL_SIG has no LENGTH prefix. Every SIG_ENTRY carries the LENGTH of its KIND_FIELDS after SIG_KIND.

vectors.name: signing_response_silent_payment_global
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 for a silent payment send whose two inputs the signer both owns, paying two scan keys: SIG_KIND 0x02 (tapkey) entries for inputs 0 and 1 with 64-byte signatures of 0x01 and 0x02, then for each scan key a SIG_KIND 0x06 (sp ecdh share) and a SIG_KIND 0x07 (sp dleq proof) with GLOBAL true and INPUT_INDEX 0. SCAN_KEY 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x5a has the SHARE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0xa0 and a 64-byte PROOF of 0xb0; SCAN_KEY 0x03 then 32 bytes of 0x5b has the SHARE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0xa1 and a 64-byte PROOF of 0xb1. Every SIG_ENTRY carries the LENGTH of its KIND_FIELDS after SIG_KIND: 0x41 for a tapkey, 0x43 for a share, 0x62 for a proof.

vectors.name: signing_response_silent_payment_per_input
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 for a silent payment send to one scan key (0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x5a) where the signer owns inputs 0 and 2: for input 0 a SIG_KIND 0x02 (tapkey) entry with a 64-byte signature of 0x01, a SIG_KIND 0x06 (sp ecdh share) with GLOBAL false and the SHARE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0xa0, and a SIG_KIND 0x07 (sp dleq proof) with GLOBAL false and a 64-byte PROOF of 0xb0; for input 2 the same three entries with a signature of 0x03, the SHARE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0xa2 and a PROOF of 0xb2. Every SIG_ENTRY carries the LENGTH of its KIND_FIELDS after SIG_KIND.

vectors.name: signing_response_unknown_sig_kind
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with two entries: first an entry for input 0 of SIG_KIND 0x08, reserved and unknown to this version, with LENGTH 4 and the KIND_FIELDS deadbeef; then a SIG_KIND 0x02 (tapkey) entry for input 0 with LENGTH 0x41 and a 64-byte signature of 0x01. A reader skips the first entry by its LENGTH, without rejecting the message, and reads the tapkey signature after it.
